list.subtitle: Client letters and other incoming mail: registration and the director's resolution
list.caption: Incoming letters
list.select: Show letter {{number}} in the side panel

awaiting.title: Nothing needs your decision yet
awaiting.text: New letters arrive from CRM once a request is created and from the office clerk once registered. Letters that are already decided are under the "All" filter.

other.title: No letters with this status
other.text: Pick another status or open all letters.

all.title: No incoming letters yet
all.text: Client letters arrive from CRM once a request is created; the office clerk registers the rest. This is where the director adds a resolution.

loadError.title: Letters did not load
loadError.text: Try again. If it keeps failing, write to the administrator.

unavailable.title: Document flow is not responding
unavailable.text: The service is temporarily unavailable. No letters are lost, try again in a minute.

forbidden.title: Incoming letters are not open to you
forbidden.text: The section is for roles that handle incoming letters. Need access? Write to the administrator.

notGranted.title: No access to document flow
notGranted.text: Your account has not been added to document flow yet. Write to the administrator.

notFound.title: Letter not found
notFound.text: Check the number or open the letter from the incoming list.

card.title: Letter {{number}}
card.bySystem: By the system, from a CRM request
card.returned: The letter was returned to the manager
card.readOnlyHint: The director decides on the letter.
card.partial: Request data is unavailable: the step is shown from the letter itself.

dup.title: {{number}} is a duplicate
what: The letter gets the status «Duplicate» and a link to the original
Its instructions and acknowledgements are cancelled, logged
The incoming number is not reused
dup.bannerText: The letter is closed: work continues on the original.

errors.not_found: No incoming letter with this number
errors.same_letter: That is this letter — give the original
errors.original_is_duplicate: That letter is a duplicate itself — give the original
errors.resolution_exists: Resolution already made — confirm cancelling instructions
errors.calc_in_progress: Calculation is under way — close it in the project
errors.invalid_state: The letter is already marked as duplicate
errors.letter_has_duplicates: This letter already has duplicates — mark the other letter of the pair

awaitingReadOnly.title: The letter is waiting for the director's resolution
awaitingReadOnly.text: The director adds the resolution. You can see the letter and its status; no decision is needed from you.

decided.title: A decision on the letter has been made
decided.text: What was decided and by whom is in the letter card, under "Director's decision".

decidedOffice.title: Resolution given
decidedOffice.text: Instructions, deadlines and progress are in the letter card, under "Instructions".

form.name: Director's resolution

text.label: Resolution text
text.hint: Assignees receive this text in their task.

assignees.hint: Tick who costs the letter and pick an employee for the zone.

directory.forbidden: Choosing assignees is unavailable: your roles cannot read the employee list. Write to the administrator.
directory.unavailable: The employee list did not load. Try again.

margin.label: Margin not below, %
margin.hint: Optional. The director will not be able to approve a quote with a margin below the threshold.

consequence.title: What will happen
consequence.step1: The letter leaves "Awaiting resolution" and gets the status "Resolution added".
consequence.step2: The chosen assignees get a costing task: your text and the due date {{due}}.
consequence.step2NoDue: The chosen assignees get a costing task: your text and the costing due date.
consequence.step3: The request moves to the "Costing" step. Nothing is sent to the client.

other.title: If no resolution is needed
other.commentHint: Required: the manager will see it and the request gets this reason.
other.disabled: The buttons stay inactive until there is a comment: say what to fix or why you reject.
other.returnHelp: Return: the letter goes back to the manager with your comment.
other.rejectHelp: Reject: the request moves to "Lost" with this reason.

errors.duePast: The due date cannot be in the past.
errors.margin: Margin is a number from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.

failed.resolve: Resolution not saved: {{reason}}. Your text is kept in the draft.
failed.return: Letter not returned: {{reason}}. Your comment is kept in the draft.
failed.reject: Letter not rejected: {{reason}}. Your comment is kept in the draft.

reasons.due_in_past: the due date is in the past
reasons.not_active_employee: the assignee is not found or disabled
reasons.duplicate: one employee is listed twice in the same zone
reasons.invalid_state: the letter is no longer awaiting resolution, refresh the card
reasons.eds_not_granted: you have no access to document flow
reasons.forbidden: this action is not allowed for your role
reasons.track_mismatch: the letter has a different resolution path, refresh the card
reasons.not_allowed_for_info: "For information" has no responsible employee or deadline
reasons.extension_pending: an extension request is already awaiting a decision
reasons.not_resolution_author: the resolution author decides on extensions
reasons.no_pending_extension: there is no extension request any more, refresh the card
reasons.report_required: a report, a file or an outgoing number is required
reasons.outgoing_linked_elsewhere: this outgoing letter already answers another incoming letter — enter the outgoing number of this one or write a report

done.resolve: Resolution added: the task went to the assignees
done.return: The letter was returned to the manager

form.draft: A draft you did not send has been restored.

register.subtitle: A letter from the tax authority, a bank, a supplier or a government body — on paper, from the taxpayer cabinet or by email. The director adds the resolution.

kind.label: Document type
kind.unavailable: The list of types did not load. Refresh the page.

method.label: Received via
method.unavailable: The receipt methods did not load. Refresh the page.

sender.label: Correspondent
sender.hint: The organisation or person the letter came from

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: Optional. If empty, the card shows the subject.

documentDue.label: Deadline in the document
documentDue.hint: Reply or action deadline set by the sender

addressee.label: Addressee
addressee.hint: Who the letter goes to for resolution. Empty — the director.

files.label: Document file
files.hint: A scan or file of the letter is required. PDF, images, Office documents, up to 25 MB. Do not upload passports or personal documents.

deal.label: Link to a request or project

related.label: Related document
related.hint: Optional: number of a previous incoming (ВХ) or our outgoing (ИСХ)

duplicate.exactTitle: This letter seems to be registered already
duplicate.reason: Why is it a different letter
duplicate.reasonRequired: Give a reason — it goes to the log

consequence: The letter gets a ВХ number and the status “Awaiting resolution”.
The director sees it in “Tasks” and adds the resolution.
The card opens in “Incoming letters”; the file is kept with the documents.

errors.receipt_method: Select how the letter was received.
errors.received_at: Enter the date received — not later than today.
errors.subject: Enter the subject.
errors.file_ids: Attach the letter file and wait for the upload.
errors.related_number: No document with this number. Check the ВХ or ИСХ number.
errors.forbidden: registering incoming letters is not part of your role
errors.server: the server did not accept the data, try again in a minute

draft.hint: The director approves the draft in one click or edits it.
draft.acquaintHint: Staff from the letter’s copy; optional

ai.hintText: PDF with text — the assistant suggests fields. Scans and photos — by hand.
ai.hintScans: PDF or photo of the letter — the assistant suggests fields, check them.
ai.applied_one: Filled from the file: {{count}} field — check those marked “Suggested by AI”.
ai.applied_few: Filled from the file: {{count}} fields — check those marked “Suggested by AI”.
ai.applied_many: Filled from the file: {{count}} fields — check those marked “Suggested by AI”.
ai.applied_other: Filled from the file: {{count}} fields — check those marked “Suggested by AI”.

errors.scan_recognition_disabled: This is a scan or photo: the assistant does not read those right now. Fill it in manually.
errors.file_too_large: The file is over 5 MB — the assistant cannot read it. Fill in manually.
errors.ai_unavailable: The assistant did not respond. Fill in manually or try later.
errors.ai_budget_exceeded: The assistant's daily limit is used up. Fill in manually.
errors.nothing_recognized: The assistant found nothing in the file. Fill in manually.
errors.unsupported_file: You can fill from a PDF or a photo of the letter.
errors.DEFAULT: Could not fill from the file. Fill in manually.

office.name: Director's resolution
office.draftIntro: Prepare a draft: the director approves it in one click or edits it.

kindHint.execute: The executor does it and reports in "Tasks".
kindHint.reply: The executor prepares a reply: registering an outgoing letter "in reply to" closes the instruction.

template.execute: Please execute and report on time.
template.reply: Please prepare a reply on time.

due.label: Deadline
due.hint: Suggested — {{date}}: by the document deadline and urgency; weekends move to Monday.

text.label: Resolution text
text.hint: Template by type — you can edit it.

co.label: Co-executors
co.hint: Optional: they get the same instruction with the same deadline.

consequence.title: What happens
execute: The letter becomes "In execution" and goes under control.
Executors get the instruction in "Tasks", the bell and Telegram.
Reminders: one working day before the deadline and on the day; after it — "Overdue".
When everyone is done, the letter becomes "Executed" and you are notified.
draft: The director sees the draft in the resolution form and approves it in one click or edits it.

staff.unavailable: The employee list did not load.

other.title: If no resolution is needed
other.commentHint: Required: the registrar sees it in the card.
other.disabled: Buttons are disabled until there is a comment: write what to fix or why you reject.
other.returnHelp: Return — the letter goes back to the registrar (registration error).
other.rejectHelp: Reject — the letter is closed with this reason.

errors.duePast: The deadline cannot be in the past.

done.resolve: Resolution given: the instruction went to executors

templates.hint: Fills the fields — you can still edit them.
templates.none: No templates yet — save a resolution as a template.
templates.unavailable: Templates did not load — fill in manually.
templates.name: Template name
templates.nameHint: For example: “Tax office — reply by accounting”.
templates.shared: Shared — for everyone who prepares resolutions

errors.name_taken: A template with this name already exists.
errors.company_template_admin_only: Shared templates are managed by an administrator.
errors.invalid: Check the people in the resolution: someone is disabled.
errors.DEFAULT: Could not save the template. Try again.

decide.title: Deadline extension: your decision is needed
decide.text: {{name}} asks to move the deadline from {{old}} to {{new}}.
decide.urgent: The letter is urgent: the deadline cannot be extended — you can only reject the request.

tasks.title: Instruction on letter {{number}}
tasks.subtitle: The letter, your instruction and actions on it

noTask.title: Nothing is expected from you on this letter
noTask.text: The instruction is executed or assigned to someone else. Progress is under "Instructions".

complete.title: Mark as executed
complete.reportHint: What was done. A report, a file or an outgoing number is required.
complete.outgoingHint: If you replied with a letter: its number from "Documents", e.g. ИСХ-014/26.
complete.error: Write a report, attach a file or enter the outgoing number.

reply.hint: "New document → Letter" "in reply to {{number}}": registering the letter closes the instruction.

ext.title: Running late? Request an extension
ext.urgent: The letter is urgent: the deadline cannot be extended, the director can only reject the request.
ext.pending: The request to move the deadline to {{date}} is awaiting the director's decision.
ext.errorDue: The new deadline must be after the current one ({{date}}).
ext.done: Extension request sent to the director

acq.title: Acknowledge
acq.text: The director added you to "Acquaint". Read the letter and mark it.

mail.subtitle: Shared mailbox letters: handle each — register it as incoming, create a lead or archive it

off.title: Mail is not connected
off.text: The administrator connects the shared mailbox in Settings · Connections · Mail → “Receiving”. Letters will then appear here automatically.

empty.title: No new letters
empty.text: Shared mailbox letters appear here within 2 minutes after they arrive.

new.title: No new letters
new.text: Shared mailbox letters appear here within 2 minutes after they arrive.

mine.title: Nothing in progress with you
mine.text: Take a letter from New and it will show up here.

in_work.title: Nothing in progress
in_work.text: Letters that someone took are visible here to everyone.

done.title: No handled letters yet
done.text: Letters with an outcome land here: incoming number, lead, reply or archive.

all.title: No letters
all.text: Shared mailbox letters will appear here once they arrive.

spam.title: No suspicious mail
spam.text: Mail from the Spam folder lands here if the folder is chosen in the receiving settings.

history.title: No letters from history
history.text: The administrator loads old letters in Settings · Connections · Mail.

search.title: Nothing found
search.text: Change the query: we search by sender and subject.

skippedReason.type: this file type is not accepted

mail.tooLarge: The letter is larger than 60 MB: only headers were saved — open it in the mailbox.

assist.title: Assistant suggestion
assist.intro: The assistant suggests the letter type and an action. Email addresses, phones, TINs, PINFLs, passport, card and account numbers are hidden; attachments are not sent. You can handle the letter without it.
assist.note: The suggestion does nothing by itself — you choose the action.
assist.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable now — handle the letter manually or try later.
assist.suggestsType: The assistant suggested a type — confirm it with the main button or change the type.
assist.noType: The assistant found no suitable type — pick one yourself.

actions.title: What to do
actions.registerWhat: The “Register incoming” form opens with the letter data and attachments; after registration the letter leaves the queue.
actions.leadWhat: A lead appears in the Inbox without a manager — a manager will take it. If a lead with this address exists, the letter is added to it as a note. The letter leaves the queue.
actions.archiveHint: For example: advertising, duplicate, not for us
actions.archiveWhat: The letter leaves the queue for the archive with the reason; it stays in the mailbox.
actions.leadDone: Lead {{number}} created — a manager will take it
actions.leadNote: The letter was added to lead {{number}}
actions.priceHow: Open the price upload, upload the letter attachment and come back here.
actions.priceWhat: Once the price list is uploaded, the letter leaves the queue as “Price uploaded”.
actions.priceConfirm: Price uploaded — remove from the queue
actions.handoverNone: Nobody to hand over to: no employee can confirm payments. Assign such a role in Settings · Roles.
actions.handoverWhat: The letter leaves “New” and appears in Tasks of the chosen colleague.
actions.suspiciousWhat: The letter moves to the Suspicious tab — you can bring it back from there (“Not spam”). The mailbox itself is not changed.
actions.priceHandoverNone: Nobody to hand over to: no employee may upload price lists and see supplier prices. Assign such a role in Settings · Roles.
actions.priceHandoverWhat: The letter leaves “New” and appears in Tasks of the chosen colleague, who will upload the price list.
actions.priceHandoverDone: Letter handed over for price upload: {{name}}
actions.completeWhat: The letter leaves the queue with the outcome “Handled”. Nothing else happens.

reply.title: Reply
reply.label: Reply text
reply.what: The letter goes from the company’s shared address as a reply in the same thread.
reply.sent: The reply is queued for sending
reply.awaiting: Awaiting an answer — keep the letter in progress
reply.sentAwaiting: Reply sent, the letter stays in progress

mail.fromMailFailed: Could not copy the attachments — attach the files manually.
mail.spamIntro: Mail from the mailbox Spam folder. Return the ones you need to the queue.

spamEmpty.title: No suspicious mail
spamEmpty.text: Mail from the Spam folder lands here if the folder is chosen in the receiving settings.

historyEmpty.title: No mail from history
historyEmpty.text: An administrator loads older mail in Settings · Connections · Mail.

spam.title: Suspicious mail
spam.what: Arrived in the mailbox Spam folder. Check the sender and the text.
spam.hint: To keep this sender out of Spam, mark them “Not spam” in your mail.
spam.notSpamWhat: The mail goes to “New” like any other
spam.discardWhat: “Remove” archives it with the reason “Spam”; nothing is deleted

mail.returned: The letter is back in New
mail.ownHint: Another colleague handles this letter, or it is for your information: you can open and read it.
mail.registeringWaiting: Awaiting confirmation: registration was not confirmed within 10 minutes.

busy.title: The letter is already with {{name}} since {{time}}
busy.what: The letter moves to you, it disappears from {{name}}’s “Mine in progress”, the action goes to the journal

bulk.label: Selected letters
bulk.title: Archive: {{count}}
bulk.what: The selected letters go to the archive with this reason; those a colleague holds and those already handled stay where they are.

action.thread_reply: the client replied in the thread

type.title: Letter type
type.empty: No type yet — pick one or press “Suggest”.

rule.what: New letters from it get this type by themselves, before the assistant.
rule.created: Rule created. More letters got the type: {{count}}
rule.publicDomain: This is a public mail service — the rule will catch letters from anyone. An exact address is better.

senderCheck.unverified: The sender is not verified: the SPF/DKIM/DMARC check failed, the address may be forged. The rule type was not set.
senderCheck.unknown: The sender cannot be verified: the letter has no mark from the mail server. The rule type was not set.

check.checking: Checking — letters will appear in the list on their own
check.tooSoon: You can check again in {{count}} s

error.default: Could not connect to the mail server
error.auth_failed: The mail server did not accept the login or password
error.mailbox_missing: There is no such folder on the mail server

settings.subtitle: Letter lists, resolution templates and the registration AI assistant.
settings.readOnly: View only: an administrator changes the lists.

dict.title: Lists
dict.hint: New values appear in forms at once. A used value can only be hidden.
dict.name: Name
dict.nameHint: Empty — the Russian name is shown.
dict.hiddenToast: Hidden: no longer offered in forms
dict.shownToast: The value is back in forms
dict.consequence: The value disappears from the list and forms. No letters use it.

errors.name_taken: This name is already in the list.
errors.value_in_use: Letters already use this value — it can only be hidden.
errors.dictionary_closed: This list can only be renamed.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only an administrator can change the lists.

rules.title: Sender rules
rules.hint: Letters from an address or domain get the type by themselves, before the assistant.

empty.title: No rules
empty.text: Add a rule or create one from a letter card.

errors.mail_type_inactive: This type is hidden — choose another.
errors.DEFAULT: Could not save the rule. Check the address or domain.

rules.publicDomain: This is a public mail service — the rule will catch letters from anyone. An exact address is better.

templates.title: Resolution templates
templates.hint: The director picks a template in the resolution and edits it. Own templates — from the resolution form.
templates.name: Name
templates.dueHint: Empty — the letter's suggested due date.
templates.consequence: The template disappears from “From a template”. Existing resolutions do not change.

empty.title: No templates
empty.text: Add a shared template for typical letters.

ai.title: Fill from file
ai.hint: Registration assistant: called by a button, suggests fields, a person decides.
ai.text: PDFs with text are always read: data from the chosen protection policy is hidden before it reaches the model.
ai.off: The assistant is not set up: no model gateway key. The form is filled in manually.

scans.label: Read scans and photos of letters
scans.hint: Do not upload passports or personal documents.
scans.on: The assistant reads scans and photos of letters from organizations.
scans.off: The assistant does not read scans and photos: fill those in manually.
scans.strict: Under the Strict policy scans and photos are not sent to the model.

policy.title: Data protection for AI
policy.hint: What is hidden in the text sent to the model: the mail assistant and “Fill from file”. Logs always hide everything. AI suggests, a person confirms.
policy.businessText: Passport, personal ID (PINFL), card numbers and birth dates are hidden. Company details, phones, email and names stay.
policy.strictText: Phones, email, tax IDs and bank accounts are hidden too. Scans and photos are not sent to the model.
policy.readOnly: Only an administrator changes the policy.
policy.pending: Document flow has not applied the “{{name}}” policy yet and still works by “{{current}}”. This usually takes a few seconds; if it does not pass, reload the page or tell the system administrator.

reply.title: Reply to the letter
reply.draft: Reply draft, not yet handed over for registration.
reply.handed: Draft handed over to the records clerk for registration.
reply.noMail: Sent outside the system or not sent by email.
reply.sending: {{number}} registered, the letter is on its way to the addressee.
reply.failedHint: The records clerk will send it again from the outgoing letter card.
reply.prefilled: Filled in from {{number}}: check the correspondent, email and subject.
